item.title: Help Shape the New ICA Research Agenda
item.description: The current ICA Research Agenda was published in 2009. Since then, cartography and GIScience have advanced onsiderably—scientifically, technologically, and societally. To capture these developments and address emerging needs, the ICA is now updating its Research Agenda. Our goal is to identify the key research questions and grand challenges that will guide Cartography and GIScience over the […]

item.title: President’s Blog: Season’s Greetings
item.description: Dear Friends and Cartographers, on behalf of the International Cartographic Association I would like to express the best wishes of the Executive Committee of ICA to all of you for a joyful festive season. We are looking forward a most successful and exciting cartographic year 2026! – Georg Gartner President of the International Cartographic Association

item.title: First ICA Fact Sheet published
item.description: The ICA has started to publish Fact Sheets on key topics in cartography. The first issue was edited by Michael T. Gastner and Kerkovits Krisztián of the ICA Commission on Map Projections on an often-debated topic: Choosing World Map Projections — When Equal-Area Is Appropriate (and Why There Is No Single “Correct” Projection)
